title: Build and audit a reproducible backtest

objectives.text: Compose complete point-in-time close selection,historical-only synthetic signal,next-open cost/capacity ledger and versioned content manifest into an auditable pure backtest.
Audit decision evidence,full ledger/terminal state and replay/future-prefix invariants while keeping strategy selection,inference,storage and real-market/production qualification separate.

blocks.markdown: This complete source composes the earlier revision selector and next-open engine without fragment imports. It supports ONEpermanent synthetic asset A,integer observation/availability clocks,integer cents,one share or flat target,and a fixed positive-rise signal. No fitted parameters,cross-validation,external dataset,universe service,corporate actions or live account is hidden inside. It is a small auditable research slice,not every technique taught in this module exposed through one API.

For decision timet,select the latest eligible revision for current close observationtand previous observationt-1ASOFt. If either required observation is unavailable,fail rather than forward/backward fill silently. Compare current-minus-previous close to a declared integer threshold;target1only if the rise is STRICTLYgreater,otherwise0. A correction to the previous observation available by tmay legitimately affect this NEWsignal,butcannot rewrite already executed earlier decisions.

blocks.title: From vintage evidence to actual modeled cash

steps.text: Own closes100,110,105,108are available at their respective0..3times;threshold0produces targets0,1,0,1. Those are close-time targets,not same-bar fills.
At time2open112,the prior target1buys one at114with spread1+slip1and fee1,cash885. Mark105gives equity990. At time3open104,target0sells at102less fee1,cash986,flat.

Final pending target1has no next opening and is not filled. The manifest includes the exact raw revision set,opening scenarios,threshold,cash/costs,runtime and kernel tag;decision evidence stores actual chosen rows. Adding a future correction may change raw content IDbutmust not alter earlier decisions/ledger.

blocks.caption: Expected:targets(0,1,0,1);fills(0,0,1,-1);final986pending1;replayTrue;future correction same ledgerTrue new content IDTrue;required point-in-time close unavailable. Full selector+engine+facade,strict schema/domain/max bounds inherited. Own manifest preserves raw row order,so a permutation can change content IDwhile selected decisions/ledger remain equivalent. Kernel tag is not a source hash;separate build/source ledger binds actual code. Pure return only,no durable artifact or app-runner certification.

blocks.markdown: Inspect chosen current/previous revision rows and their availability<=decision,threshold comparison,target creation,next-open execution,capacity/unfilled size,commission cashflow,inventory,mark and final pending state. Reconcile independent cashflow/quantity totals to final equity. Retain raw/config/build/runtime IDs and rejected-input reasons without leaking credentials. A run IDhelps bind content,not authenticate supplied timestamps or prove the dataset has every historically relevant event.

Change future-only revisions or later openings and compare earlier decision/ledger prefixes. Valid future data must not change an earlier state;invalid whole-input data may correctly reject the full run. Adding raw data can legitimately change the manifest IDwithout changing model outputs. Test exact availability and threshold boundaries,missing required observation,wrong asset,revision conflict,zero capacity/insufficient cash and final unexecuted target. Replay equality alone is not independent mathematical or market validation.

The threshold is supplied and recorded,not optimized here. If a researcher tries many thresholds,that is a search requiring the prior trial/temporal/held-out protocol;do not treat this run's final profit/loss as an unbiased chosen-strategy estimate. The toy fair-sign test is not automatically applicable. Compare appropriate same-rule baselines/costs and report all runs/failures before any claim about strategy performance. A deterministic losing sample is not a problem to fix by changing labels or deleting trades.

This facade returns one validated candidate dictionary. Persisting it can use a separately reviewed content-keyed artifact protocol,butthat integration is NOTimplemented by this pure return. Do not claim durable history,concurrent publication,backup or a distributed batch scheduler. Actual app renderer/math/code/task/mobile/a11y/offline/recovery and any deployment/risk review must be checked on the actual current revision. Source-level tests and educational assessments are not professional/trading competence proof.

Independent transfer:build a separate cashflow audit from selected opening fills and confirm986;independently reconstruct each signal from eligible revisions. Perturb only a future correction and confirm prior decisions unchanged while content identity changes. Make a previous-close revision arrive at a current decision and explain the causal signal change;make it arrive one step later and exclude it. Report missing data as failure with no stale successful report,then define a held-out threshold-selection experiment WITHOUTusing this final sample for both choosing and testing.

Technical pieces inherit original [ALFREDvintage semantics](https://alfred.stlouisfed.org/help/downloaddata),[Backtradernext-bar principle](https://www.backtrader.com/docu/order-creation-execution/order-creation-execution/),[PythonJSON](https://docs.python.org/3.12/library/json.html),[hashlib](https://docs.python.org/3.12/library/hashlib.html),and scoped prior source review. The one-asset rise rule,exact costs and audit manifest are own synthetic design,not a validated profitable strategy.

summary: A reproducible backtest traces point-in-time selected rows to historical close signals,next-open fills,cash/positions/marks and terminal state with content/build evidence. Causal replay and independent accounting are necessary source checks,not strategy selection/inference,market realism,durable storage or app/production approval.
